name: No Passing Zone (pennant)
spec: yellow sideways triangle (pennant) pointing right with black legend NO PASSING ZONE
meaning: Do not pass; this pennant marks the start of a no-passing zone on the left side of the road.

snippets.back: The NO PASSING ZONE warning sign stands on the left side of a two-lane road to warn where a no-passing zone begins.
The guide identifies a red or orange pennant on a bicycle as an indication of a rider with impaired hearing and recommends slowing.
A pennant-shaped sign marks where a no-passing zone begins.
Round signs foretell rails ahead and beg slower eyes and ears, and three-cornered pennants on the left rim of two-way two-lane roads open a marked no-passing stretch.
The no-passing pennant stands on the left road edge and identifies the beginning of a no-passing zone.
A no passing zone sign is a pennant-shaped yellow and black sign that supplements the do not pass sign, and it stands on the left side of the road pointing to the start of the no-passing zone.
The pennant hangs on the left side of the road and warns you that passing is prohibited ahead.
The pennant-shaped No Passing Zone sign stands on the left side and warns that passing is prohibited for that lane.
